title: Telly Swing
tagline: Swing, plug in and power your way home!
description: Telly is a little cartoon TV with a power cord. Roll and jump through eight hand-built rooms, swing from hooks, push crates onto plates and plug into sockets that power doors, lifts, fans and bridges, then plug in at the gold outlet. Three stars a room.
how_to: ◀ ▶ roll Telly along and ⤒ jumps; hold ⤒ while falling to fire Telly's hover jets.
🔌 near a glowing hook throws the cord: hold to swing, pump ◀ ▶ for momentum, or swing right round to wrap it for extra speed.
🔌 beside a socket plugs in to power doors, lifts, fans and bridges. Push crates onto plates—or hold 🔌 beside a crate to pull it back.
Stomp or whip 🔌 at patrolling Static Bugs and Volt-Bots, grab ⚡ and the three 🔋 in each room, then plug into the gold outlet!
